items.summary: Fix the monthly total volume calculation so it correctly reflects total volume for each habit in the selected month using these formulas: (1) for workout-style numeric volumes, monthly total = (per-completion volume) × (number of completed days); (2) for reps-only habits, monthly total = (per-completion reps) × (number of completed days); (3) for time-based habits, monthly total = (per-completion time) × (number of completed days) computed in seconds when a time string is available, then formatted back to M:SS. Ensure this works consistently for all time-based habits (not only a special-cased habit name).

Add a selected-month aggregate total volume summary that sums volumes across all habits for the selected month and displays separate totals at minimum for: total reps (sum of per-habit monthly totals for unitType "reps"), total time (sum of per-habit monthly totals for unitType "time" in seconds, formatted as M:SS), and total workouts numeric volume (sum of per-habit monthly totals for workout-style numeric unit types if present). The summary must match the corrected per-habit totals from REQ-1.
